p-section.p-paragraph: Arcade cheats need Pugsy's MAME Cheat Collection (cheat.7z) and work once it is imported. The collection is kept up by Pugsy and many contributors and isn't included with RetroGo, so download and import it with the steps below. It only takes a minute or two.
In Safari, open mamecheat.co.uk, tap MAME Cheat Files at the top, then tap the first item in the list, such as XML Cheat Collection for MAME 0.279.
Tap Download when asked. You get a zip file (for example cheat0279.zip). No need to unzip it.
Back in RetroGo, tap Import Cheat Collection. In the file picker, open iCloud Drive › Downloads and choose the zip you just downloaded.
Can't find it? Without iCloud Drive, the file is in On My iPhone › Downloads. You can also look in Recents in the file picker, where a new download is usually at the top.
Once imported, the cheat list of each arcade game shows its cheats. When a new release of the collection comes out, import it again the same way.
p-section.p-footer: Cheats are made by Pugsy and the collection's contributors; see Credits & Notes on the Arcade Cheats page. RetroGo is not affiliated with mamecheat.co.uk; if cheats don't work as expected in RetroGo, please report it to RetroGo first.
